Maya: heads up — i'm bringing up pavo-3b v1 on dev. want a quick sanity harness run: basic instruct prompts, format checks, and hallucination probe. can anyone own QA/pass criteria? :wave:
Arun: i'll take basic correctness. i'll run the canned golden prompts + a few adversarial ones. share the prompt set or link.
Maya: pasted below. also small perf note: model in fp16 -> we'll try int8 later. initial perf looks fine.
Maya: ```
# golden prompts
1) Q: "Summarize the following text in one sentence: ..."
2) Q: "List pros/cons of using postgres vs snowflake for small analytics"
3) Q: "Write python function to dedupe a list while preserving order"
```
Jen: i'll kick off int8 quant smoke on a single dev pod, low priority. expect throughput + latency numbers in ~30m. i'll report perf/regression.
Sam: qa-bot ran auto-evals on 50 random dev prompts — failure rate 3/50 (formatting/stop token issues). attaching brief log.
ops-bot: deploy bot: pavo-3b:v1 deployed to devstg-3 — 1 replica. logs: https://ci.internal/runs/321
Arun: seeing a consistent truncation issue when prompt ends with code block. example: "```
print('hi')
```" -> model omits closing code fence.
Maya: noted. add to fail list. probably tokenization/truncation. i'll try forcing stop tokens in decoder config.
Jen: if truncation persists after quant, we should compare fp16 baseline. i'll keep both runs.
Sam: quick checklist proposal:
- run golden prompts (pass/fail per prompt)
- run 200 random assist prompts (stat)
- check stop-token behavior with code blocks
- run int8 quick quant and compare 100 prompts vs fp16
- note latency and p50/p95
- create a short bug with repro if fail
Maya: perfect. tagging @Arun @Jen for updates. i'll add the checklist to the intake ticket: https://tracker/RED-456
Arun: started runs. will post summarized table here when done. :thumbsup:
Jen: int8 job queued (job id 789). will post perf + score diff.
Sam: QA note: also test multi-turn chat continuity — 20 dialogues, scoring for context retention.
Maya: thanks all. aim to have a go/no-go by EOD. :rocket:
